sahneler.metin: A cruise liner burned off the New Jersey coast.
Fire swept through the ship, and one hundred thirty seven people died.
It began in a storage locker.
The ship's interiors were full of wooden panelling.
Wind and open doors fed the fire.
The captain had died hours earlier, leaving confusion on the bridge.
The burning hull drifted onto the beach at Asbury Park.
Ships then had to use fire-resistant materials and run fire drills.

aciklama:
Morro Castle burned off the coast of New Jersey. The cause: rapid fire spread through combustible panelling, aided by open doors and delayed response.

#shorts #engineering #firesafety
